name: documented-skill-contract
description: Instantiates a new Markdown rendering (page-structure) template file from this plugin's canonical generic or standard-manual starter -- headings, body, and media placeholders, backed by real standard manual rendered-output evidence. Not an agent/native-skill instruction template (that is Task 0.7/0.8's separate template system).
prompt: Use the create-markdown-rendering-template skill according to its SKILL.md. State the expected inputs, outputs, safety boundaries, and what the skill must not do.
expected: Uses the skill documented in SKILL.md
Identifies the required input artifacts or parameters
Identifies the expected output or report artifact
Respects the documented plugin boundaries and non-responsibilities
Does not invent destructive tenant writes or bypass required confirmation gates
